summary: Exterior painting season drove the month, with local search doing the heavy lifting on lead flow. Quote requests trended up week over week while cost per lead stayed inside the target range.
coverSub: A peak-season look at how local search visibility turned exterior painting demand into quote requests.
headline: June is the heart of exterior season and the numbers followed: quote requests climbed week over week while cost per lead held steady. July's job is converting that momentum into booked projects.
snapshotLead: Homeowners paint in the summer and search right before they do. Lead flow tracked the season, with exterior jobs leading the request mix.
takeaway: Painting demand is seasonal, so every June lead matters twice: once as a project and again as a review that fuels next season. Speed to quote is the multiplier right now.

campaigns.name: Local search: Exterior Painting
campaigns.note: Exterior intent leads the summer mix and gets priority visibility.

wins: Lead volume grew 17% as exterior season peaked, with the request mix skewing toward higher-ticket jobs.
Cost per lead fell 5% even while volume climbed, so visibility gains are coming from earned rankings.
Local search views rose 12%, widening the top of the funnel heading into July.
actions: Tighten speed-to-quote on new leads, the single biggest conversion lever during peak season.
Launch a review-request sequence against June's completed projects.
Stage fall interior-and-cabinet messaging now so the pipeline doesn't dip when exterior season ends.
quote: Exterior season doesn't wait, and neither should a quote. Fast follow-up is where June's leads become July's revenue.
